Sparse Voxel Rasterization (SVRaster) - emergentmind.com
Sparse Voxel Rasterization is a technique that uses adaptive, explicit sparse voxels with per-corner attributes to render volumetric graphics in real time. The method employs a hierarchical octree and dynamic Morton ordering for strict front-to-back compositing, which reduces common artifacts in volumetric rendering.
